name: fantasy_jewel_samurai
source: 원본(사무라이 여전사 홀로그램 보석 갑옷) + GPT 역설계본의 프롬프트 박스
genre: ultra-detailed fantasy warrior portrait, photorealistic digital painting, realistic anime doll-like face

subject.face: porcelain soft skin, icy blue eyes, sharp direct gaze, soft red lips, pale-blonde/silver bangs
subject.hair: high ponytail, wispy flying strands, fine individual hair lines
subject.headwear: ornate gold crown with turquoise/blue gems, pearls, dangling filigree
subject.costume: armor-kimono, iridescent holographic embroidery, white+gold+cobalt+magenta+violet+crimson, dragon/cloud motifs, pearls, layered sculpted pauldrons
subject.weapon: katana, gold ornate tsuba, white-blue wrapped hilt, steel blade diagonal across frame

camera: low dynamic angle, slight dutch tilt, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on face and eyes, creamy golden and blue bokeh, motion blur on hair/blade
lighting: warm orange-gold rim light from right + cool cyan/blue fill, volumetric light, high contrast, glossy reflections
palette: cool blue + gold dominant, warm orange accents (keep warm rim; GPT version drifted too cool)
quality_words: 8k, ultra-detailed, detailed textures, cinematic composition, soft skin, reflective surfaces
known_weaknesses_to_fix: 의상 문양이 노이즈처럼 뭉개짐 -> 'clearly readable dragon and cloud motifs' 추가
칼날 하이라이트 번짐 -> 'crisp polished steel blade with sharp specular line, no glow bleed'
색이 차갑게 쏠림 -> 'warm orange-gold rim light, keep warm tones'
workflow: 원본을 참조 이미지로 넣는 i2i 편집 모델 사용 (se-gpt-image-2-edit-i2i)
